author: Tanvir Ahmed
text: The Smoked Kacchi Biryani is hands down the best in Dhaka right now. The aroma of charcoal smoke paired with fall-apart tender goat meat is unmatched.

author: Nusrat Jahan
text: An enchanting dining atmosphere in Dhanmondi. The Royal Shahi Beef Rezala with warm garlic naan took me back to regal Mughal banquets.

author: David Miller
text: Visiting from London and this was our culinary highlight. The Tandoori Jumbo River Prawns and Saffron Firni are world-class.

author: Sadia Rahman
text: From table booking to dessert service, Bhojon Bilash delivers pure perfection. The staff is polite, attentive, and the Borhani is perfectly balanced.
